title: Steamworks
gap: No experience or tour offerings stated
blurb: Steamworks Brewing Co. sells packaged beer products including Steamworks Classic Mash-Up, Steamworks Hoppy Mash-Up, and Steamworks Mash-Up 12 Pack. Customers can redeem proofs of purchase from these products for swag items by emailing receipts. The program requires accumulation of proofs of purchase and has specific terms and conditions for redemption.
extraNote: Proofs of purchase must be redeemed within one (1) year of purchase. · No cash value. No substitutions. · Proofs of purchase may not be auctioned, sold, copied, or duplicated in any way. · Steamworks Brewing Co. reserves the right to discontinue this program or any product at any time without notice.
